name: chamfer_3x6_bevel
why: Two different sides: it is `DistanceDistance`, the bevel of the weld. IF THE ENUM ENDED UP ON `AngleDistance` the second side would be ignored and 3*3/2*100 = 450 would be removed instead of 900 -- half, and the part would come out with a wrong preparation without anything failing.

expect._why_exact: 120000 minus 3*6/2*100 is an exact calculation. If the second side were ignored it would be 119550
